contract.governing_equations: The supplied CPTP independent-increment phase law has psi(w)=(32/25)[sqrt((15eta/4)^2+w^2)-15eta/4]. At fixed finite volume and weak hopping, q=2epsilon^2|Txy|^2 gamma/(gamma^2+Delta^2), gamma=eta+psi(Delta). It obtains .97q*<=q<=q* for the independent-edge optimum gamma*=max(eta,|Delta|). Common reversible Dirichlet forms, capacities, gaps and Markov-additive transport inherit their precise comparisons; arbitrary first-hit probabilities and nonequilibrium currents do not. The universal symmetric-Levy edge ceiling .972848925... is class-specific, not an arbitrary-control limit.
